BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fire suppression regulation; adding a newsection to chapter 81.44 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 81.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The commission shall establish regulations to minimize the riskof fire resulting from railroad operations or maintenance. (2) No person may operate railroad equipment or perform railmaintenance, including rail grinding, welding, or vegetation clearing,without complying with requirements adopted by the commission tominimize risk of fire. (3) Each violation of this section is punishable by a monetarypenalty of one thousand dollars.
